questions.question: Are official practical driving test routes published?
options: No, test routes are not published
Yes, every centre uses one fixed route
questions.explanation: Official test routes are not published, so practise reading signs and road markings.

questions.question: What should you watch for when turning onto a main road?
options: New speed-limit signs and faster traffic
Wait until cars behind sound their horn
questions.explanation: Speed limits often change at junctions with main roads, so scan for roundels early.

questions.question: What is a common hazard when leaving a business or industrial estate?
options: Parked vehicles and limited view at the junction
National speed limit signs on every gate
questions.explanation: Parked vans and narrow exits can block your view, so emerge slowly and safely.
